name: codecraft
description: CodeCraft: a VS Code interface for TrueForge agents, with gated review and Code Town.

codecraft.baseUrl.description: TrueForge base URL. Must be a loopback address (localhost, 127.0.0.1 or ::1).

codecraft.primaryModel.description: Model name for the primary agent, as registered in TrueForge. Keys are configured only in TrueForge.

codecraft.fallbackModel.description: Model name for the fallback agent, as registered in TrueForge (any provider). Used when a run on the primary agent fails. Change it here to swap providers; no code change needed.

codecraft.testCommand.description: Command run by the run_tests tool in the workspace, after you confirm. TrueForge has no sandbox on Windows, so it runs on your machine.

codecraft.contextBudget.description: Token budget (estimated as characters / 4) for repository context CodeCraft adds in front of a request. 0 disables automatic context.

codecraft.mcpPort.description: Loopback port for the CodeCraft editor-tools MCP server that TrueForge calls. If it is in use, a random free port is used.

enumDescriptions: Scout walks to what the agent is doing and shows short tips
Hide Scout, its speech bubble and its tips (Ask Scout still answers when you ask)
codecraft.scout.description: Scout, the Code Town guide. It never edits files, runs tasks or calls a model.

codecraft.scoutAskCamera.description: When you ask Scout a question, the Code Town camera eases over to frame him (never with reduced motion).

enumDescriptions: Follow the operating system's reduced-motion setting
No animation in Code Town; frames are drawn only when something changes
Animate Code Town (string lights, light shafts, power plant)
codecraft.townReducedMotion.description: Reduced motion for Code Town. Applies immediately to an open Code Town panel.

codecraft.faultInjection.markdownDescription: **Testing only.** Makes the primary model's first turn of EVERY run fail with a real TrueForge error of this kind, to exercise retries, failover and the circuit breaker. `cut_stream` drops the connection after the first model message and resumes the same turn. Use the panel's *Inject fault…* button for a single run. Keep `none` for normal use.

scripts.town-preview: node esbuild.mjs && node esbuild.mjs --scenarios && node out/scenarios/town-preview.js
scripts.town-perf: node esbuild.mjs && node esbuild.mjs --scenarios && node out/scenarios/town-perf.js
scripts.test:vscode: node esbuild.mjs && node esbuild.mjs --vscode && node out/vscode/run.js
